name: Goa
description: India's premier beach state, famous for sun-kissed coastlines, Portuguese colonial architecture, vibrant nightlife, water sports, and spicy seafood curries.

attractions.name: Baga Beach & Water Sports
attractions.description: Energetic beach offering parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and famous beach shacks like Britto's.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada & Lighthouse
attractions.description: 17th-century Portuguese fortress overlooking the vast Arabian Sea with a four-storey historic lighthouse.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Trek
attractions.description: A magnificent four-tiered waterfall cascading through lush Western Ghats forest, accessible via jeep safari.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Roman Catholic basilica in Old Goa housing the sacred relics of St. Francis Xavier.

attractions.name: Anjuna Flea Market & Curlies Sunset
attractions.description: Bohemian flea market with handmade trinkets, live music shacks, and iconic sunset chill-out spots.

travel_tips: Rent a scooter (₹350-₹500/day) for maximum mobility and scenic coastal road drives.
North Goa is best for nightlife and water sports, while South Goa is ideal for serene, uncrowded beaches.
Must try: Goan fish curry thali, Bebinca dessert, and fresh cashew feni.
Beware of overpriced beach taxi unions; pre-negotiate or use GoaMiles cab app.

name: Manali
description: High-altitude Himalayan resort town nestled in Himachal Pradesh, famous for snow-capped peaks, pine forests, Solang Valley adventure sports, and cafe culture.

attractions.name: Solang Valley Adventure Arena
attractions.description: Hub for paragliding, zorbing, ATV quad biking, and skiing during winter snow months.

attractions.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Waterfall
attractions.description: World's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet leading into the dramatic Lahaul Valley and Sissu waterfall.

attractions.name: Hadimba Devi Ancient Temple
attractions.description: 16th-century wooden pagoda temple surrounded by cedar forest (Dhungri Van Vihar).

attractions.name: Old Manali Cafes & Beas River Walk
attractions.description: Artisan cafes offering wood-fired trout pizza, Israeli shakshuka, live acoustic music, and riverbank trails.

travel_tips: Carry heavy woolens, thermal inners, and waterproof boots during Dec-March.
Pre-book Rohtang Pass permits online 3-5 days in advance as vehicle entries are restricted.
Try local Siddu (steamed stuffed wheat bread) and fresh rainbow trout.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City of Rajasthan, steeped in regal Rajput history with hilltop forts, opulent royal palaces, vibrant bazaars, and traditional Rajasthani cuisine.

attractions.name: Amber Fort & Palace
attractions.description: Majestic yellow sandstone hilltop fortress featuring Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) and panoramic Maota Lake vistas.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
attractions.description: Five-storey pink sandstone facade with 953 honeycomb jharokha windows built for royal women.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Hilltop fort offering spectacular sunset views over the entire illuminated Pink City skyline.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar & Bapu Bazaar
attractions.description: Vibrant lanes for silver jewellery, block-print textiles, blue pottery, and handcrafted Mojari footwear.

travel_tips: Buy the composite monument ticket (₹300 for Indians / ₹1000 for foreigners) covering 8 major sights.
Feast on authentic Dal Baati Churma at Rawat Mishthan Bhandar or Chokhi Dhani.
Beware of unverified gemstone dealers; bargain politely in bazaars.

name: Kerala (Munnar & Alleppey)
description: God's Own Country, famed for emerald tea plantations in misty Munnar hills, serene backwater houseboat cruises in Alleppey, and Ayurvedic rejuvenation.

attractions.name: Alleppey Backwaters Houseboat Cruise
attractions.description: Glide through tranquil palm-fringed canals, paddy fields, and lagoons aboard a traditional Kettuvallam.

attractions.name: Munnar Tea Gardens & Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Rolling hills blanketed in lush green tea bushes and home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat.

attractions.name: Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets & Heritage
attractions.description: Iconic cantilevered Chinese fishing nets along the coastline with colonial Portuguese streets and spice markets.

travel_tips: Book government DTPC shikara boats in Alleppey if on a budget (₹800/hr) instead of a full houseboat.
Experience authentic Kerala Sadya served on a banana leaf and Karimeen Pollichathu (pearl spot fish).
Carry insect repellent and umbrellas even during shoulder seasons.

name: Tokyo
best_season: March to May (Sakura) & Sept to Nov
description: Ultra-futuristic metropolis seamlessly blending neon skyscrapers, anime pop culture, tranquil Shinto shrines, Michelin-star dining, and world-class rapid transit.

attractions.name: Shibuya Scramble Crossing & Sky View
attractions.description: The world's busiest pedestrian intersection with rooftop 360-degree glass viewing deck at Shibuya Sky.

attractions.name: Senso-ji Ancient Temple (Asakusa)
attractions.description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple founded in 645 AD, approached through the vibrant Nakamise shopping street.

attractions.name: Akihabara Electric Town & Anime Hub
attractions.description: Epicenter of otaku anime culture, multi-level retro gaming arcades, and electronics superstores.

attractions.name: teamLab Planets Immersive Digital Art
attractions.description: Groundbreaking interactive body-immersive museum where you walk through water and crystal light installations.

travel_tips: Purchase a Suica/Pasmo IC card or 72-hour Tokyo Subway ticket for seamless metro transit.
Tipping is strictly not customary in Japan; exceptional service is already standard.
Must try: Tonkotsu Ramen at Ichiran, fresh sushi at Tsukiji outer market, and 7-Eleven egg salad sandwiches.

name: Paris
best_season: April to June & Sept to Nov
description: The City of Light, renowned worldwide for timeless art, haute couture, romantic boulevard cafes, gourmet patisseries, and iconic monuments like the Eiffel Tower.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars
attractions.description: Wrought-iron lattice tower standing 330m high with sparkling light shows every hour after dusk.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum & Mona Lisa
attractions.description: World's largest art museum housed in former royal palace, showcasing Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

attractions.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Basilica
attractions.description: Historic bohemian hilltop district once frequented by Picasso, with breathtaking panorama of Paris.

travel_tips: Book Louvre and Eiffel Tower tickets at least 3-4 weeks ahead to bypass multi-hour queues.
Watch out for pickpockets and petition sign scams around Sacré-Cœur and Eiffel Tower.
Greet shopkeepers with a polite 'Bonjour' before asking questions; it opens doors in Paris.

name: Bali
description: Island of the Gods, celebrated for jungle wellness retreats in Ubud, emerald rice terraces, cliffside sea temples in Uluwatu, surf beaches, and sunset beach clubs.

attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Jungle Swing
attractions.description: Dramatic stepped green valley with traditional Balinese Subak irrigation and giant high-flying swings.

attractions.name: Uluwatu Cliff Temple & Kecak Fire Dance
attractions.description: Ancient sea temple perched on 70-meter limestone cliffs overlooking crashing waves, featuring sunset fire dance.

attractions.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
attractions.description: Early morning hike up an active volcano to watch the golden sunrise above the sea of clouds.

travel_tips: Use Grab or Gojek apps for cheap bike rides and food delivery across Seminyak and Canggu.
Wear a sarong (provided at entry) when visiting Balinese Hindu temples.
Indulge in Nasi Goreng, Babi Guling, and fresh young coconuts.

name: Dubai
description: Glittering Arabian metropolis famous for record-breaking skyscrapers like Burj Khalifa, luxury desert dune bashing, futuristic museums, and lavish mega-malls.

attractions.name: Burj Khalifa At The Top (124th & 125th Floor)
attractions.description: Ascend the tallest building on earth (828m) in 60-second high-speed double-decker elevators.

attractions.name: Red Dunes Desert Safari & BBQ Camp
attractions.description: Thrilling 4x4 dune bashing across red sands, camel riding, sandboarding, and Tanoura fire show under stars.

attractions.name: Museum of the Future
attractions.description: Torus-shaped architectural masterpiece clad in Arabic calligraphy exploring humanity in 2071.

travel_tips: Use Dubai Metro Red line which connects DXB Airport, Burj Khalifa, Mall of the Emirates, and Marina.
Dress modestly in government buildings and old souks.
Visit Dubai Gold and Spice Souks in Deira and take a traditional 1 AED Abra boat across Dubai Creek.
